name: Agent pack
description: Example sub-agents and skills: a code reviewer, a docs writer, commit messages and changelog entries.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a diff or a set of files for bugs, risky changes and missing tests. Use it after larger edits.
agents.instructions:
You review code changes.

1. Read the changed files.
2. List real bugs first, then risky changes, then missing tests.
3. Quote file paths and line numbers.

skills.name: commit-message
skills.description: How to write a commit message for this team. Load it before writing any commit message.
skills.content:
# Commit messages

- Conventional Commits: feat, fix, docs, chore.
- Subject at most 72 characters, imperative mood.
- Body: what and why, wrapped at 72 characters.
